sections.title: Unit 36: The Hungarian Tradition of Liberty
body: Hungarian political thought has a long debate about freedom, law and responsibility.

This capstone unit is about Deák Ferenc (passive resistance and constitutional continuity), Eötvös József (rights and education) and Bibó István (freedom without fear). You recap earlier forms and learn the words for civic life.
